# LemLib is the Lem runtime library for Lean, from the lem-lean fork
# (repo migrated septract -> OathTech 2026-08 [USER 2026-09-02]; the offline
# redirect in deps/gitconfig covers both spellings, so resolution is unchanged).
# arc-8 close: pinned to the MERGED mdd/lean-backend head (arc-8 pin dance;
# DAEMON/DAEMON1/legacy failwith removed from LemLib in this lineage);
# arc-10 S2: bumped to the arc/robustness lem head (Sum BEq/Ord, R1 +
# comparison derivation backend); re-pin to the merged head at arc close.
# effect-retirement C1: bumped to the arc/effect-retirement lem head
# (L0 fix-first + L1 supply/reader_consumer/fuel-budget features +
# audit response); C2: bumped to the L2 deletion head (runEffectful
# axiom + effectful mechanism retired — LemLib declares ZERO axioms);
# re-pin to the merged head at arc close (pin dance).
# pin-bump 2026-09-03: bumped to the merged mdd/lean-backend head 3c88f0d
# (the parity-fix arc: OCaml-order derived Ord, Pset/Pmap verbatim ports,
# right-to-left draw order, lem* deep-list rewrites, division-by-zero
# panics; lem-lean doc/lean-backend/2026-09-03_parity-fix-record.md).
# fuel-parameter C1 2026-09-04: bumped to the merged mdd/lean-backend head
# 742506d (the fuel-parameter + structural + fuel-measure arcs: fuel is the
# `[LemFuel]` class instance, `lemDefaultFuel` and the numeric budget form
# deleted, generated `_lemFuel_zero` lemmas, `fuel_consumer`/`structural`/
# `fuel_measure` declares; lem-lean doc/lean-backend/2026-09-04_fuel-
# parameter-record.md; this repo: docs/2026-09-04_fuel-parameter-C1-record.md).
# … then to the merged head ecf75b4 (the D2 enablers: backend-derived
# `t.lemSize` structural sizes, `lemSize x` fuel measures, fuel-lifted
# `inductive R [LemFuel]` for indreln premises; lem-lean doc/lean-backend/
# 2026-09-04_d2-enablers-record.md) — the pin at which the real tree generates.
# fuel-parameter C3 2026-09-05: bumped to the merged head d4ba548 (the
# tails-and-pmap-laws slice: a measured/structural definition's trailing
# lambda binders are hoisted into the head on the Lean target — `lemTail`
# for a `function` scrutinee — so the six point-free tails can carry a
# `fuel_measure`; `LemLibPmapLaws`; the reserved-name capture check on
# target_rep text; lem-lean doc/lean-backend/2026-09-05_tails-and-pmap-laws-
# record.md; this repo: docs/2026-09-05_fuel-parameter-C3-record.md).
# fuel-parameter C4 2026-09-05: bumped to f6542f8 (the measure-hypothesis
# slice: `declare {lean} fuel_measure val f = `μ` assuming `H`` — the
# obligation gains the reserved `lemHyp : H` binder immediately before
# `lemFuel`, the wrapper stays fuel-free; the UTF-8 letter-like tokenizer
# and the projection-on-non-parameter refusal in the measure renderer;
# lem-lean doc/lean-backend/2026-09-05_measure-hypothesis-record.md; this
# repo: docs/2026-09-05_fuel-parameter-C4-record.md).
# program-data-parameters S0.5 2026-09-19: bumped to 4307dc5 (N-ary
# `reader_seed`: with N declared readers a seed def's first N parameters
# seed them, positionally in the global sorted reader order; the "exactly
# one declared reader" guard deleted; lean-lib/ byte-identical to f6542f8;
# lem-lean doc/lean-backend/2026-09-19_nary-reader-seed-record.md; this
# repo: docs/2026-09-19_program-data-parameters-S0.5-record.md).
# program-data-parameters S1.5 2026-09-20: bumped to 38f87d5 (fuel'd
# TRULY-MUTUAL blocks compose with reader lifting: the a618b9c scope-cut
# guard "'declare {lean} fuel val' in a mutual block combined with reader
# lifting" deleted — workers, wrappers, `fuel_measure` obligations and
# `_zero` lemmas of a lifted mutual block carry the reader binders as the
# single-def case does; supply x mutual and seed x mutual stay refused;
# lean-lib/ byte-identical to 4307dc5; the cerberus trees byte-identical at
# this pin (no fuel'd mutual block is reader-lifted at the current .lem);
# lem-lean doc/lean-backend/2026-09-20_fuel-mutual-reader-record.md; this
# repo: docs/2026-09-20_program-data-parameters-S1.5-record.md).

lean_frontend/speclab/lakefile.toml.text:
# speclab — the harness-family differential-lane package: pure-Lean
# models + codecs + the mkHarness C renderer, and the emit/gate test
# exes the scripts/test_speclab*.sh differential lanes consume
# (oracle-vs-Lean comparisons on rendered harness programs; the
# pinned-term drift gates re-parse tests/speclab/*.core).
#
# Dependency direction (the one-way gate pattern, standing forward-
# design constraint): speclab REQUIRES CerberusLean (the semantics);
# nothing under the semantics may reference speclab.
#
# packagesDir points at the parent workspace's package store so the
# git dependency (LemLib) is SHARED — no re-clone, offline-safe.

name = "speclab"
defaultTargets = ["SpecLab"]
moreLeanArgs = ["-DautoImplicit=false"]
packagesDir = "../.lake/packages"

[[require]]
name = "CerberusLean"
path = ".."

# The SpecLab library (a single root module suffices — the `SpecLab`
# prefix is unique to this package).
[[lean_lib]]
name = "SpecLab"

# S0 sanity/emit executable: codec + renderer round-trip checks
# (exit 0 on pass) and the identity-harness emitter consumed by
# scripts/test_speclab.sh. Pure Lean — no semantics imports, hence no
# native/*.o link args needed (add them when a speclab exe first
# imports the semantics).
[[lean_exe]]
name = "speclab-test"
srcDir = "test"
root = "Unit.SpecLabTest"

# arc-15 S1: test library (the root CerberusLeanTest pattern) — makes
# the test/Unit modules importable across the speclab test exes.
[[lean_lib]]
name = "SpecLabTestLib"
srcDir = "test"
globs = ["SLUnit.+"]

# arc-15 S1: the divmod kernel-instance term-emission instrument
# (adapted from the reasoning-era root emit-lean-core instrument — parked
# on tag park/reasoning-era-20260831 — attributed in-file).
# Imports CoreParser (the semantics package), hence the native link
# args.
[[lean_exe]]
name = "speclab-emit-core"
srcDir = "test"
root = "SLUnit.EmitCoreMain"
moreLinkArgs = ["../native/md5.o"]

# arc-15 S1: the DivModCore drift/param/exec gate. Re-parses the
# pinned Core dumps and runs the emitted terms through the generated
# drive — semantics imports, native link args.
[[lean_exe]]
name = "speclab-core-test"
srcDir = "test"
root = "SLUnit.CoreGateTest"
moreLinkArgs = ["../native/md5.o"]

# arc-15 S2: the R2 byte-blaster term-emission instrument (same
# fidelity contract; plan in SLUnit.EmitCore).
[[lean_exe]]
name = "speclab-emit-bytearr"
srcDir = "test"
root = "SLUnit.EmitByteArrMain"
moreLinkArgs = ["../native/md5.o"]

# arc-15 S2: the ByteArrCore drift/param/exec gate.
[[lean_exe]]
name = "speclab-bytearr-core-test"
srcDir = "test"
root = "SLUnit.ByteArrGateTest"
moreLinkArgs = ["../native/md5.o"]

# arc-15 S3: the R3 linked-list term-emission instrument.
[[lean_exe]]
name = "speclab-emit-list"
srcDir = "test"
root = "SLUnit.EmitListMain"
moreLinkArgs = ["../native/md5.o"]

# arc-15 S3: the ListAppendCore drift/param/exec/LEAK gate.
[[lean_exe]]
name = "speclab-list-core-test"
srcDir = "test"
root = "SLUnit.ListGateTest"
moreLinkArgs = ["../native/md5.o"]

# arc-15 S4: the R4 tree-rotation term-emission instrument.
[[lean_exe]]
name = "speclab-emit-tree"
srcDir = "test"
root = "SLUnit.EmitTreeMain"
moreLinkArgs = ["../native/md5.o"]

# arc-15 S4: the TreeRotCore drift/param/exec/LEAK gate.
[[lean_exe]]
name = "speclab-tree-core-test"
srcDir = "test"
root = "SLUnit.TreeGateTest"
moreLinkArgs = ["../native/md5.o"]

tests/mem-scale-probes/micro/lakefile.to.text:
# memscale-micro — the MEMORY-SCALE arc's micro-benchmark executable
# (arc/mem-scale, 2026-09-01): times the CerbMem byte-path primitives in
# isolation (allocation list, per-byte map insert/lookup, memValueToBytes,
# reconstructValue, bytesToInt) so the scaling study's per-class costs can
# be attributed to a named code path. Measurement instrument only — NOT a
# gate, NOT part of the semantics. Same one-way dependency shape as
# speclab: requires CerberusLean by path, shares the workspace package
# store (offline-safe; no re-clone).
name = "memscale-micro"
defaultTargets = ["memscale-micro"]
moreLeanArgs = ["-DautoImplicit=false"]
packagesDir = "../../../lean_frontend/.lake/packages"

[[require]]
name = "CerberusLean"
path = "../../../lean_frontend"

[[lean_exe]]
name = "memscale-micro"
root = "Micro"
moreLinkArgs = ["../../../lean_frontend/native/md5.o"]
